lines.text: Here's my hot take: pineapple belongs on pizza.

data.define: An opinion that is strong and often unpopular.

example.text: Here's my hot take: pineapple belongs on pizza.

misuse.text: Don't call plain facts a 'hot take'.
misuse.why: It means a bold, debatable opinion.

data.l1_ex: Hot take nè: dứa hợp với pizza đó.

native.tip: “hot take” = Quan điểm gây tranh cãi. Ví dụ: “Here's my hot take: pineapple belongs on pizza.”
